run_pose_inference_torchserve: run pose model inference on an image using both native PyTorch and TorchServe and compare results
run_top_down_pose_inference: run top-down pose estimation inference on an image using an MMPose model and save visualization
run_bottom_up_pose_inference: run bottom-up pose estimation inference on an image using an AssociativeEmbedding model and save visualization
test_torchserve_endpoint: test a TorchServe endpoint by sending an image and comparing server results against native PyTorch inference
visualize_pose_results: visualize pose estimation results from both PyTorch and TorchServe inference and save as PNG images
